# The Great British Bake Off Dataset & AI Training Corpus

> A comprehensive tidy relational dataset and AI training corpus for the television competition series The Great British Bake Off (broadcast as The Great British Baking Show in North America).

The Great British Bake Off (GBBO) dataset provides structured, relational tables adhering to tidy data principles across 15+ UK series. The dataset is exported in CSV, Apache Parquet, SQLite (`gbbo.db`), Apache Arrow IPC, and native R (`.rds`, `.rda`) formats, alongside fine-tuning JSONL, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) knowledge corpora, and evaluation benchmarks.

For complete zero-hop documentation in a single prompt-ready file, see [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nicholaswilde/the-great-british-bake-off/main/llms-full.txt).

## Core Relational Tables

The dataset consists of 4 normalized relational tables linked by explicit foreign keys:

- [seasons](https://github.com/nicholaswilde/the-great-british-bake-off/blob/main/data/processed/seasons.csv): Series-level summaries including winner, series year, judges, presenters/hosts, UK broadcast network, filming location, and North American streaming collections (PBS, Netflix, The Roku Channel).
- [bakers](https://github.com/nicholaswilde/the-great-british-bake-off/blob/main/data/processed/bakers.csv): Contestant demographics including baker name, series number, age, occupation, hometown, overall finish placement, and official headshot image URLs.
- [episodes](https://github.com/nicholaswilde/the-great-british-bake-off/blob/main/data/processed/episodes.csv): Episode-level metadata including episode ID (`sXXeYY`), theme week (e.g. Cakes, Bread, Pastry), original broadcast air date, and challenge time allowances.
- [performances](https://github.com/nicholaswilde/the-great-british-bake-off/blob/main/data/processed/performances.csv): Granular challenge outcomes per baker and episode, recording signature bakes, technical challenge rankings, showstopper bakes, elimination/star baker results, and Hollywood Handshakes.

## AI Training Corpora & Benchmarks

The dataset provides structured LLM training and evaluation assets in `data/ai/`:

- [gbbo_qa_finetuning.jsonl](https://github.com/nicholaswilde/the-great-british-bake-off/blob/main/data/ai/gbbo_qa_finetuning.jsonl): 1,900+ multi-turn chat instruction pairs formatted for OpenAI and Gemini SFT fine-tuning. Covers winners, challenge dishes, technical ranks, star bakers, and eliminations.
- [gbbo_knowledge_corpus.jsonl](https://github.com/nicholaswilde/the-great-british-bake-off/blob/main/data/ai/gbbo_knowledge_corpus.jsonl): 370+ chunked narrative knowledge documents for vector databases and RAG retrieval pipelines (series overviews, episode narratives, baker profiles).
- [gbbo_benchmark_suite.jsonl](https://github.com/nicholaswilde/the-great-british-bake-off/blob/main/data/ai/gbbo_benchmark_suite.jsonl): 45 curated evaluation questions covering trivia, multi-hop reasoning, show rules, and Hollywood Handshake accolades with keyword verification rubrics.

## Multi-Format Distribution

- **CSV (`data/processed/*.csv`)**: Standard comma-separated tables.
- **Apache Parquet (`data/processed/*.parquet`)**: Columnar storage preserving strict data types.
- **Apache Arrow IPC (`data/processed/arrow/*.arrow`)**: Zero-copy in-memory streaming.
- **SQLite (`data/processed/gbbo.db`)**: Self-contained SQL relational database with indexed primary and foreign keys.
- **R Package (`r/`)**: Native `.rds` and `.rda` binaries with roxygen2 documentation for tidyverse and RStudio users.

## Quickstart CLI & Tasks

```bash
# Export all datasets and AI corpora
task export:all
# Or via CLI
uv run gbbo export-ai

# Run AI evaluation benchmark
task eval:benchmark
# Or via CLI
uv run gbbo eval-benchmark

# Publish or dry-run Hugging Face sync
task publish:hf -- --dry-run
# Or via CLI
uv run gbbo publish-hf --dry-run
```
